about.title: Your Trusted Partner in Industrial Cleaning <blue>Solutions</blue>
about.description: PT Tirta Mega Nusantara (TMN) has been a trusted provider of tank cleaning, industrial cleaning, sludge removal, pumping, tank washing, and hazardous waste management services since 2007.
about.description2: With more than 19 years of experience, we are committed to delivering professional services for the Oil & Gas, Marine, Chemical, Manufacturing, Tank Terminal, and various industrial sectors while prioritizing quality, safety, and customer satisfaction.
about.about-content-1: Established in 2007, PT Tirta Mega Nusantara has grown into one of Indonesia's leading industrial cleaning companies, providing reliable tank cleaning, sludge removal, industrial waste management, and environmental services.
about.about-content-2: Supported by experienced professionals, certified procedures, and modern equipment, we are committed to delivering safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible solutions for a wide range of industries across Indonesia.
